description: Source code for DDR initialization and configuration routines for ox820 platform, including timing parameters, hardware register manipulations, and DDR setup functions.

methods.name: ddr_phy_poll_until_locked
methods.description: Polls DDR PHY register until the clock is locked.

methods.name: ddr_poll_until_not_busy
methods.description: Polls DDR status register until the DDR core is not busy.

methods.name: ddr_issue_command
methods.description: Issues a command to DDR and waits until completion.

methods.name: ddr_timing_initialisation
methods.description: Initializes DDR timing registers with specified parameters.

methods.name: ddr_normal_initialisation
methods.description: Performs DDR normal initialization sequence based on configuration parameters.

methods.name: ddr_setup
methods.description: Configures DDR core with specific timing and configuration parameters.

methods.name: init_ddr
methods.description: Starts DDR clocks and initializes DDR hardware at specified MHz.
